title: jasminum sambac var. normale
intro: Jasminum sambac var. normale, commonly known as the Arabian Jasmine or Night-Blooming Jasmine, is a fragrant, evergreen climbing shrub native to tropical Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to promote relaxation, reduce stress and anxiety, and improve sleep quality due to its calming and sedative effects. The health benefits of Jasminum sambac var. normale include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-inflammatory effects.
